title: fix(components): KbdGroup declares the kbd it renders, not a div (objectui#8576)
body:
Fixes #8576

⚠️ **Generic arguments are spelled in words in this body** — `ComponentProps OF "div"`, never the angle-bracket form. This is a pull request about type shapes, and GitHub's body sanitizer eats tag-shaped fragments even inside backticks and fences (AGENTS.md, "GitHub 会改写你写进 issue/PR 正文的字节"); on the sibling card a before/after table of exactly these types collapsed into two identical strings, i.e. into "nothing changed".

## What changes

`KbdGroup` in `packages/components/src/custom/kbd.tsx` annotated its props `React.ComponentProps OF "div"` and returned a `kbd`. The annotation now names `"kbd"`. **Nothing rendered moves** — this component has always put a `kbd` in the DOM, and upstream shadcn ships the same element.

Direction 1, type follows element, per the dispatch ruling: `kbd` is what ships and what upstream ships, a `kbd` grouping `kbd`s is legal HTML, and making the element follow the declaration instead would change the DOM every existing consumer already receives. The half that was lying is the half that moved.

## The measurement that had to come first

The card required this before any instrument was designed, because objectui#8571 shrank from a type-safety repair to a documentation repair exactly for want of it. Measured in this tree, one narrow program per leg, TypeScript 6.0.3 / `@types/react` 19.2.18 — the same versions objectui#8571 was measured under:

| leg | reading |
| --- | --- |
| `Equal` of ComponentProps OF "div" and ComponentProps OF "kbd" | **false — the two types DIFFER** |
| positive control, same program: `Equal` of ComponentProps OF "div" and ComponentProps OF "p" | **true** — objectui#8571's reading reproduced |
| `keyof` of the two props types | identical |
| members `HTMLDivElement` adds over `HTMLElement` | exactly one, the deprecated `align` |
| ComponentProps OF "div" assignable to ComponentProps OF "kbd" | true |
| the reverse direction | false |
| `RefObject` of `HTMLDivElement or null` accepted by the new props' `ref` | true |
| ref callback taking `HTMLDivElement or null` accepted by the new props' `ref` | true |
| the intersection of the two props types equal to either side | false / false |

The positive control is why the first row is a reading and not a broken `Equal`.

⇒ **Unlike objectui#8571, `tsc` IS a discriminating instrument on this card.** The difference is carried entirely by the element type parameter, not by the prop names: `HTMLAttributes` is one interface for every element, so what actually moves is `ref` and `currentTarget`. All three instruments are therefore pinned: the SOURCE pin (the class-wide sweep next door), the TYPE pin (new, erased at runtime, compiled by `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` which the package `type-check` script chains), and the DOM pin (new, `tagName` after a real render).

## Premise P1 — the call-site census

The dispatch hung the ruling on P1: no call site depends on the props being `div`-shaped.

* **In this repository: zero call sites.** `KbdGroup` appears in exactly four places tree-wide — its own definition, its `export`, the sweep's ledger line, and one comment. No `.tsx`, `.mdx`, example or app renders it. (`content/docs/components/data-display/kbd.mdx` documents the SDUI `kbd` schema and its registry renderer, a different module that does not import `KbdGroup`.)
* **For consumers of the published package the props type WIDENS, so nothing that compiled stops compiling** — ComponentProps OF "div" is assignable to ComponentProps OF "kbd" and not the reverse (measured above), and a `div`-typed ref object or ref callback is still accepted (measured, and pinned in the new test).
* The only shape that moves is code reading a `div`-only member off an inferred `ref` or `currentTarget`, and there is exactly one such member: the deprecated `align`.

P1 holds. The props were never widened, unioned, or erased — see the caricature section.

## The ratchet, exercised in the required order

PR #8574 ledgered this component as an accepted exception, `'kbd.tsx:KbdGroup': 'div -> kbd'`. That line was deleted **first**, with the declaration still `"div"`, and the sweep was run before any repair was written:

```
× every judged member under src/custom names the intrinsic it returns, except the ledgered cards
AssertionError: expected { 'kbd.tsx:KbdGroup': 'div -> kbd' } to deeply equal {}
Tests  1 failed | 6 passed (7)
```

So the guard is known to SEE this, by test name, rather than assumed to. The repair came after; the ledger is now empty, which is the ratchet at its floor — any disagreement under `custom/` now fails outright.

## The caricature, refused by both instruments

Widening the props to `ComponentProps OF "div"` intersected with `ComponentProps OF "kbd"` — the shape the card and the dispatch both named as the red line — was run as its own ablation from the committed tree:

```
AssertionError: expected { 'kbd.tsx:KbdGroup': 'div & kbd -> kbd' } to deeply equal {}      (source pin, red by name)
src/__tests__/kbd-group-props-name-the-element-8576.test.tsx(114,26): error TS2344         (type pin, _Group)
src/__tests__/kbd-group-props-name-the-element-8576.test.tsx(119,38): error TS2344         (type pin, _GroupIsNotWidened)
```

On objectui#8571 that caricature was invisible to `tsc`, because all three types were one type. Here it is refused by the type pin as well as the source pin — measured, both directions.

## Ablations and controls

Both legs mutate from the **committed** tree, prove the mutation reached disk (marker counts and `git hash-object` blob, with a hard abort if it did not), and restore under a `trap`; restoration is verified by STATE — `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob back to `9f05260fdbdf7295e7ca66137b8ad59b721e3a76` — never by an exit code.

| leg | source pin (sweep) | type pin (`tsc`) | DOM pin (render) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| the repair, at HEAD | green | green | green |
| declaration reverted to `"div"` | **red by name** | **red**, lines 114 / 116 (`_Group`, `_GroupIsNotDiv`) | green |
| declaration widened to the intersection | **red by name** | **red**, lines 114 / 119 (`_Group`, `_GroupIsNotWidened`) | green |

The DOM pin staying green under both mutations is the honest reading, not a hole: a declaration-only change cannot move the rendered element, which is precisely why the card insisted the source pin exists. It is reported rather than hidden.

**The control moves independently.** The sibling `Kbd` in the same file already agreed with its declaration; its assertions (`_Kbd`, and its render leg) stayed green through every leg above, and the six other tests of the sweep stayed green while the seventh went red. A control that reddens with the subject would not be one.

No `dist` hop is involved in any of this: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` shows both the new test and `packages/components/src/custom/kbd.tsx` as program inputs, and the tests import `../custom/kbd` relatively, so every leg reads the source it mutated.

## Local runs (all at `2fb899321`, tree clean)

| run | result |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/` | **253 files, 2320 tests passed** |
| `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/components` | **9 tasks successful** (chains `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components lint` | **0 errors**, 941 warnings, none of them new |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | OK — 1 changeset declared for 2 published source files |
| `pnpm run changeset:check` | OK — fixed group intact, no `major` declared |
| `pnpm run type-check:coverage` | OK |
| `pnpm run check:control-bytes` | OK — 7084 tracked text files scanned |
| `pnpm run check:published-tsconfig-exclude` | OK — 34 enforced packages carry the directory form |
| `node scripts/cross-file-line-citation-census.mjs` | **identical at the branch point and here** |
| `pnpm run check:readme-exports` | **NOT MEASURED** — prerequisite unmet, see below |

Lint narrowing, stated as a measurement: the population is eslint's own resolution of `.` under `packages/components`, **468 files** counted from `--format json`, which is exactly what CI's `turbo run lint` runs for this package; the excluded remainder is the other packages' lint runs, and `eslint.config.js` declares no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and nothing in this diff can move an untouched file's verdict. The 941 warnings are the package's standing `react-refresh` noise; both touched files report 0 errors and 0 warnings.

`check:readme-exports` exits 1 in this worktree with "the population COLLAPSED — this run proves nothing" and `packagesRead: found 8, floor is 25` because 29 packages are unbuilt here. That is a prerequisite failure, not a red gate, and it is reported as NOT MEASURED rather than as either colour. The diff changes no README and no package export, and CI builds before running it.

Position axis (objectui#8875): the line-citation census reports **1267 citations / 540 false / 295 resolving / 432 unjudged** at the branch point `4e3a4f07e` and the identical four numbers here, so this change neither adds a cross-file line address nor moves a line anything cites. Nothing in the tree cites either touched file by line address; the one cross-file reference to the sweep is the new test, and it cites by NAME.

## Clause-②

**`Clause-②: yes`** — my own judgement, not inherited from the dispatch. `KbdGroup` is a published component of `@object-ui/components`, and this changes the published type surface in a way that is measurably observable to consumers: `ref` and `currentTarget` move from `HTMLDivElement` to `HTMLElement`. It adds no export and no key, so it is not the mechanical floor; it is the "unsure ⇒ yes" branch, and the sibling card is exactly why — there the two types were identical and a `no` would have been defensible on measurement, here they are not. The declaration is carried on both carriers (this pull request and the claim comment on the card), and the pull request docks in draft until the contract-review tier clears it. That docking is the safe state; nothing in the shape below was traded for it.

## 验收备注

Out-of-scope observations, none filed, none touched:

* `packages/components/src/renderers/data-display/kbd.tsx` — the SDUI `kbd` renderer wraps its keys in a `div` while `custom/kbd.tsx` uses a `kbd` for the same grouping job. Two different modules with two different jobs, and the sweep does not judge `renderers/`. Not a defect, not filed; a follow-up carrier would be objectui#8875-style consistency work, and there is no PR or person heading for that file today, so: no successor.
* The sweep's population floor (`toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(12)`) and its family enumeration remain as PR #8574 wrote them; the ledger simply became empty. Not filed.
